records.context: The Annotate app writes one ``INTEGER`` column per pass into ``png_list``. Two people labelling the same extracted image regions therefore leave two columns side by side, and this application view reports whether they agree, and on which rows they differ, before either set is used as ground truth.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.agreement#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The Annotate app writes one ``INTEGER`` column per pass into ``png_list``. Two people labelling the same crops therefore leave two columns side by side, and this screen reports whether they agree, and on which rows they differ, before either set is used as ground truth.
records.translation: Annotate 应用每进行一轮标注，就新增一个 ``INTEGER`` 列，写入 ``png_list``。因此，两个人标注同一批裁剪图会留下并列的两列；此界面会在任一组标注被用作真值之前，报告它们是否一致以及在哪些行上不同。

records.context: **Read-only, structurally.** Every connection goes through :mod:`spacr.agreement`. It opens the file with ``file:…?mode=ro`` and ``PRAGMA query_only = ON``, the same approach the Database Browser takes. Disagreements are resolved in the Annotate app; this screen does not write.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.agreement#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Read-only, structurally.** Every connection goes through :mod:`spacr.agreement`. It opens the file with ``file:…?mode=ro`` and ``PRAGMA query_only = ON``, the same approach the Database Browser takes. Disagreements are resolved in the Annotate app; this screen does not write.
records.translation: **结构上只读。** 每个连接都经由 :mod:`spacr.agreement`。它以 ``file:…?mode=ro`` 和 ``PRAGMA query_only = ON`` 打开文件，与 Database Browser 的做法相同。分歧在 Annotate 应用中解决；此界面不写入。

records.source: Ordering matters throughout and is the reason for the length. The category hints have the same constraint in reverse. The page-surface sweep runs on every route, not only where a backdrop was installed: with the ambient preference off, skipping it left every layout container carrying the blanket window fill, which is what made the settings half a solid slab.
records.translation: 顺序在整个过程中都很重要，这也是代码较长的原因。实时预览监视 ``src``，只有在两个面板都存在后才能连接，因为该字段属于设置面板，而预览属于运行时面板。类别提示有方向相反的同样约束。页面表面清理在每条路径上都会执行，而不只是在安装了背景的地方：当环境背景偏好关闭时，跳过它会让每个布局容器都带着整窗口的填充色，这正是设置区域变成一整块实色的原因。

records.context: Only Home is rebuilt when the theme changes; every other application view is re-styled in place by re-applying the QSS. That is enough for anything whose colours come from the stylesheet, and not enough for a backdrop that paints itself — the DNA rain and the ambient background both capture their flat fill colour and their wallpaper at construction. records.source: Only Home is rebuilt when the theme changes; every other screen is re-styled in place by re-applying the QSS. That is enough for anything whose colours come from the stylesheet, and not enough for a backdrop that paints itself — the DNA rain and the ambient background both capture their flat fill colour and their wallpaper at construction. Switching from dark to light left a black rain rectangle on a white page, and switching into Cell left it painting flat black over the micrograph the theme had just loaded. The ambient backdrop has exactly the same two captured values and therefore exactly the same two bugs.
records.translation: 主题改变时只有 Home 会被重建；其他每个界面都通过重新应用 QSS 就地重新设置样式。对于颜色来自样式表的内容这已足够，但对于自行绘制的背景则不够——DNA 雨和环境背景都在构造时捕获了其纯色填充和壁纸。从深色切换到浅色时，白色页面上会留下一块黑色的雨矩形；切换到 Cell 时，它会在主题刚载入的显微图像上绘制纯黑色。环境背景恰好有同样两个被捕获的值，因此也恰好有同样两个错误。

records.context: Both palette events count, and that is the whole reason this works. ``QApplication.setPalette`` — which is what :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` ends in — delivers ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **only to top-level widgets** (Qt 6.11, verified); every child, including every AppScreen inside MainWindow's stack, gets ``PaletteChange`` instead. Listening for the application event alone meant this handler fired in the tests that synthesised it and never once in the running app.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen.changeEvent#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Both palette events count, and that is the whole reason this works. ``QApplication.setPalette`` — which is what :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` ends in — delivers ``ApplicationPaletteChange`` **only to top-level widgets** (Qt 6.11, verified); every child, including every AppScreen inside MainWindow's stack, gets ``PaletteChange`` instead. Listening for the application event alone meant this handler fired in the tests that synthesised it and never once in the running app.
records.translation: 两种调色板事件都会处理，这正是它能起作用的全部原因。``QApplication.setPalette``——也就是 :func:`spacr.qt.theme.apply_qpalette` 最终调用的函数——**只向顶层控件**发送 ``ApplicationPaletteChange``（Qt 6.11，已验证）；每个子控件，包括 MainWindow 堆栈中的每个 AppScreen，收到的则是 ``PaletteChange``。若只监听应用级事件，这个处理程序只会在人为合成该事件的测试中触发，而在实际运行的应用中从未触发过。

records.context: Lists and tuples are not a corner case. Classify's ``src`` is list-valued and regression's ``count_data``, ``score_data`` and ``paired_data`` are too, and ``utils.load_settings`` turns any CSV cell starting with ``[``, ``(`` or ``{`` into a real Python container. An earlier version of this method tested ``isinstance(value, str)`` and skipped everything else, which skipped exactly the two modules whose loaders never write a local path as a fallback -- so for those the publisher's path was the panel's only source of truth. Containers are walked.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen.reanchor_example_paths#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: LISTS AND TUPLES ARE NOT A CORNER CASE. Classify's ``src`` is list-valued and regression's ``count_data``, ``score_data`` and ``paired_data`` are too, and ``utils.load_settings`` turns any CSV cell starting with ``[``, ``(`` or ``{`` into a real Python container. An earlier version of this method tested ``isinstance(value, str)`` and skipped everything else, which skipped exactly the two modules whose loaders never write a local path as a fallback -- so for those the publisher's path was the panel's only source of truth. Containers are walked.
records.translation: 列表和元组不是边缘情况。Classify 的 ``src`` 是列表值，回归的 ``count_data``、``score_data`` 和 ``paired_data`` 也是；``utils.load_settings`` 会把任何以 ``[``、``(`` 或 ``{`` 开头的 CSV 单元格转换为真正的 Python 容器。此方法的早期版本检查 ``isinstance(value, str)`` 并跳过其他所有值，而被跳过的恰好是那两个其载入器从不以本地路径作为后备的模块——因此对这两个模块而言，发布者的路径是面板唯一的依据。现在会遍历容器。

records.context: Most of the per-path work is not new. :func:`spacr.portable_paths.reroot_crop_path` already picks the deepest recorded suffix that EXISTS below the current root, so a rewrite is only made when the reconstructed path is really there; it is tried first and its answer preferred. What it cannot do is the root itself -- its resolution needs a suffix to match, and ``src`` pointing at the plate folder has none, which is the reported case. That one gap is filled by matching the destination's own folder name.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.AppScreen.reanchor_example_paths#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Most of the per-path work is not new. :func:`spacr.portable_paths.reroot_crop_path` already picks the deepest recorded suffix that EXISTS below the current root, so a rewrite is only made when the reconstructed path is really there; it is tried first and its answer preferred. What it cannot do is the root itself -- its resolution needs a suffix to match, and ``src`` pointing at the plate folder has none, which is the reported case. That one gap is filled by matching the destination's own folder name.
records.translation: 逐路径的大部分工作并不是新的。:func:`spacr.portable_paths.reroot_crop_path` 已经会选出在当前根目录下实际存在的最深的已记录后缀，因此只有在重建的路径确实存在时才会改写；它会被优先尝试，其结果也优先采用。它做不到的是根目录本身——它的解析需要匹配一个后缀，而指向板文件夹的 ``src`` 没有后缀，这正是所报告的情况。这一个缺口通过匹配目标位置自身的文件夹名来补上。

records.context: Every module application view **except** the ones that already animate something of their own — which today is exactly :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. Sequencing's rain is *about* sequencing: bases falling behind the application view that maps reads to barcodes. Putting a second, unrelated animation behind it would fight it — two independent motions competing for the same pixels, neither readable, and two animation timers executing on the one application view that already had one. So an application view gets one animated background or none, never both.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every module screen **except** the ones that already animate something of their own — which today is exactly :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`. Sequencing's rain is *about* sequencing: bases falling behind the screen that maps reads to barcodes. Putting a second, unrelated animation behind it would fight it — two independent motions competing for the same pixels, neither readable, and two animation timers running on the one screen that already had one. So a screen gets one animated background or none, never both.
records.translation: 每个模块界面都使用，**除了**那些已经有自己动画的界面——目前恰好就是 :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`。Sequencing 的碱基雨与测序*本身*相关：碱基在将读段映射到条形码的界面后方落下。在其后面再放一个无关的动画会与之冲突——两种独立的运动争夺同一批像素，哪一个都看不清，而且在原本已有一个动画计时器的界面上运行两个计时器。因此，一个界面要么只有一个动画背景，要么没有，绝不会两者兼有。

records.context: Written as a rule with a name rather than as an ``else`` on the rain's ``if``: the two backdrops are chosen by *one* decision, and the day a second module earns a themed animation of its own, adding its key to :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`-style membership is all that is needed for the ambient one to step aside.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.app_screen.uses_ambient_background#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Written as a rule with a name rather than as an ``else`` on the rain's ``if``: the two backdrops are chosen by *one* decision, and the day a second module earns a themed animation of its own, adding its key to :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS`-style membership is all that is needed for the ambient one to step aside.
records.translation: 写成一条有名称的规则，而不是作为 ``else`` 附在碱基雨的 ``if`` 之后：两种背景由*同一个*决定来选择，将来某天如果第二个模块也有了自己的主题动画，只需把它的键加入 :data:`DNA_RAIN_APPS` 式的成员集合，环境背景就会让开。

records.source: The screen is deliberately thin. Everything it knows about a queue it learns from :mod:`spacr.batch`, which is headless, torch-free and tested without Qt. This file is only the part that has to be a GUI: pick a module and a settings file, duplicate a job and edit it, reorder, validate, save/load, run, and watch per-job status, progress and log.
records.translation: 此界面有意保持精简。它对队列的全部了解都来自 :mod:`spacr.batch`，后者是无头的、不依赖 torch，并且在没有 Qt 的情况下测试。本文件只包含必须作为 GUI 的部分：选择模块和设置文件、复制作业并编辑、调整顺序、验证、保存/载入、运行，以及查看每个作业的状态、进度和日志。

records.context: **Jobs are validated when they are added, not when they run.** A job whose settings file is missing, whose ``src`` is misspelled or whose module is GUI-only is refused at the Add button, with the reason inline, instead of failing when the software job list reaches it.

records.source: **Jobs are validated when they are added, not when they run.** A job whose settings file is missing, whose ``src`` is misspelled or whose module is GUI-only is refused at the Add button, with the reason inline, instead of failing when the queue reaches it.
records.translation: **作业在添加时验证，而不是在运行时验证。** 设置文件缺失、``src`` 拼写错误或模块仅限 GUI 的作业，会在点击 Add 按钮时被拒绝，并以内联方式给出原因，而不是等到队列运行到它时才失败。

records.context: **No modal dialogs, ever.** Every failure lands in the inline problems pane and in :attr:`BatchScreen.last_error`. A ``QMessageBox`` hangs a headless run (it did, in ``MakeMasksScreen``), and this screen is exercised headlessly.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.batch#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **No modal dialogs, ever.** Every failure lands in the inline problems pane and in :attr:`BatchScreen.last_error`. A ``QMessageBox`` hangs a headless run (it did, in ``MakeMasksScreen``), and this screen is exercised headlessly.
records.translation: **从不使用模态对话框。** 每个失败都显示在内联问题窗格和 :attr:`BatchScreen.last_error` 中。``QMessageBox`` 会使无头运行挂起（在 ``MakeMasksScreen`` 中确实发生过），而此界面会以无头方式进行测试。

records.context: The run uses a worker. **Execution model:** completion returns to the GUI thread. ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted *inside the worker thread*; therefore each receiver that changes a widget uses an explicit queued connection to a bound method of this GUI-thread widget.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.batch#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The run happens off the GUI thread, and its completion handler comes back onto it.** ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted *in the worker thread*; every widget-mutating receiver therefore uses an explicit queued connection to a bound method of this GUI-thread widget.
records.translation: **运行在 GUI 线程之外进行，其完成处理程序则回到该线程上。** ``PipelineWorker.finished`` 是*在工作线程中*发出的；因此每个会修改控件的接收者都使用显式的排队连接，连接到这个 GUI 线程控件的绑定方法。

records.source: Every cell of the matrix is clickable, and clicking one asks :func:`spacr.qt.linked_selection.open_objects` for exactly the crops that cell counted, so "43 uninfected called infected" opens those 43 crops. records.translation: 矩阵中的每个单元格都可点击，点击后会向 :func:`spacr.qt.linked_selection.open_objects` 请求该单元格所统计的那些裁剪图，因此 "43 uninfected called infected"（未感染却被判为感染）会打开那 43 张裁剪图。其背后的分析位于不含 Qt 的 :mod:`spacr.confusion` 中；本文件只负责表格、两个列表和按钮。

records.context: Two lists, not one, per cell. The model being **sure** and wrong is evidence against the *annotation*; the model being **unsure** and wrong is evidence about the *boundary*. They are different diagnoses with different fixes, so they are opened separately and never blended into one confidence-sorted list where the distinction disappears somewhere in the middle of a scroll.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.classifier_evaluation#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Two lists, not one, per cell. The model being **sure** and wrong is evidence against the *annotation*; the model being **unsure** and wrong is evidence about the *boundary*. They are different diagnoses with different fixes, so they are opened separately and never blended into one confidence-sorted list where the distinction disappears somewhere in the middle of a scroll.
records.translation: 每个单元格对应两个列表，而不是一个。模型**确信**却出错，是对*标注*不利的证据；模型**不确定**而出错，是关于*边界*的证据。二者是不同的诊断，修正方法也不同，因此会分别打开，绝不会合并成一个按置信度排序的列表——那样区别会在滚动到中间某处时消失。

records.context: Each cell is also broken down per microplate sample position and per laboratory microplate, which shows where the errors came from: 43 errors spread over 20 microplate sample positions point to the model, 43 errors from one microplate sample position point to that microplate sample position.

records.translation: 每个单元格还会按孔和按板进行分解，以显示错误来自何处：分布在 20 个孔中的 43 个错误指向模型，来自同一个孔的 43 个错误则指向该孔。

records.translation: Control Charts 界面：按板绘制一个对照值的控制图，以检测漂移。

records.context: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks, and the analysis assumes that the controls behave the same way every time. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all measure against them, so when the controls drift, every downstream result shifts with them without any warning — the analysis normalises to whatever controls it is handed.

records.source: A screening campaign is dozens of plates run over weeks, and the analysis assumes that the controls behave the same way every time. Hit calling, plate normalisation and Z' all measure against them, so when the controls drift, every downstream result shifts with them without any warning — the analysis normalises to whatever controls it is handed.
records.translation: 一次筛选实验活动包括在数周内运行的数十块板，而分析假设对照每次的表现都相同。命中判定、板归一化和 Z' 都以对照为基准，因此当对照发生漂移时，所有下游结果都会随之偏移，且没有任何警告——分析会对它拿到的任何对照进行归一化。

records.context: Everything numeric comes from :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`, which has no Qt in it and documents the reasoning for every decision — most of all the central one, that sigma comes from the average moving range over d2 and never from the standard deviation of the series, because the SD is inflated by exactly the drift the chart exists to detect. This file draws that result and nothing else: no statistic is computed here, so the chart on application view and the chart in a report cannot disagree.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context

This file draws that result and nothing else: no statistic is computed here, so the chart on screen and the chart in a report cannot disagree.
records.translation: 所有数值都来自 :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.control_chart`，该模块不含 Qt，并记录了每项决定的理由——最重要的是核心的那一项：sigma 由平均移动极差除以 d2 得到，而绝不使用序列的标准差，因为 SD 恰恰会被该图所要检测的漂移所放大。本文件只绘制该结果，别无其他：这里不计算任何统计量，因此界面上的图与报告中的图不可能不一致。

records.translation: **写入前预览。** :func:`spacr.convert.scan` 和 :func:`spacr.convert.plan` 完全不写入任何内容；``Convert`` 是单独的一次按键。存在阻塞性错误（两个源冲突，映射到同一个输出名称）的规划会使 ``Convert`` 保持禁用——修正应在上游的文件夹布局中进行，而不是靠一个 "yes, overwrite" 按钮。

records.context: **Background execution.** Scanning ND2 headers takes seconds and conversion takes minutes. Both operations use :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`. Completion calls *:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`* on the GUI object instead of a closure. ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted during worker execution; a connected closure would construct widgets there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.convert#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Scanning a plate's worth of ND2 headers takes seconds; converting takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **不在 GUI 线程上运行。** 扫描一整块板的 ND2 头信息需要数秒；转换需要数分钟。两者都通过 :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 进行，并且完成处理程序通过*绑定方法*（:attr:`ConvertScreen._job_settled`）而不是闭包到达，因为 ``PipelineWorker.finished`` 是在工作线程中发出的，连接到它的闭包会在那里构建控件子对象。测试传入 ``threaded=False``。

records.context: **Prune** — the plan, in full, *before* anything happens. Every candidate with its size and the module that would make it again; every kept item with the rule that kept it, so the user can see why less space is freed than expected. Deleting requires the confirmation dialog, and the dialog shows the file list and the total one more time.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.data_manager#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Prune** — the plan, in full, *before* anything happens. Every candidate with its size and the module that would make it again; every kept item with the rule that kept it, so the user can see why less space is freed than expected. Deleting requires the confirmation dialog, and the dialog shows the file list and the total one more time.
records.translation: **Prune**——在任何操作发生*之前*完整显示规划。每个候选项都附有其大小以及能重新生成它的模块；每个保留项都附有保留它的规则，以便用户明白为何释放的空间少于预期。删除需要经过确认对话框，该对话框会再次显示文件列表和总量。

records.context: The dialog fills in two stages. The file list is not stored on the plan: every call to ``file_list`` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate directory, because a plan for a project with millions of extracted image regions must not carry millions of strings. Doing that in ``__init__`` would put a full recursive walk of the user's project on the main GUI execution path, at the one moment they are waiting for a window to appear — and on a share that is asleep, the walk's first stat alone can take twenty seconds while the mount wakes. So the dialog opens with the half that needs nothing from the disk (the totals, every candidate, every kept item and its reason) and the file list arrives behind it. Nothing is dropped: the user still reads every path before anything is deleted, which is why the acknowledgement is held disabled until the list is on application view — or, when the walk fails, until :meth:`_on_listing_failed` has said so in the list's place. The box is never enabled while the list shows a placeholder.

records.source: The dialog fills in two stages. The file list is not stored on the plan: every call to ``file_list`` runs ``os.walk`` over every candidate directory, because a plan for a project with millions of crops must not carry millions of strings. Doing that in ``__init__`` would put a full recursive walk of the user's project on the GUI thread, at the one moment they are waiting for a window to appear — and on a share that is asleep, the walk's first stat alone can take twenty seconds while the mount wakes. So the dialog opens with the half that needs nothing from the disk (the totals, every candidate, every kept item and its reason) and the file list arrives behind it. Nothing is dropped: the user still reads every path before anything is deleted, which is why the acknowledgement is held disabled until the list is on screen — or, when the walk fails, until :meth:`_on_listing_failed` has said so in the list's place. The box is never enabled while the list shows a placeholder.
records.translation: 对话框分两个阶段填充。文件列表并不存储在规划中：每次调用 ``file_list`` 都会对每个候选目录执行 ``os.walk``，因为包含数百万张裁剪图的项目，其规划不能携带数百万个字符串。如果在 ``__init__`` 中这样做，就会在 GUI 线程上对用户的项目进行一次完整的递归遍历，而且恰好发生在用户等待窗口出现的那一刻——在处于休眠状态的共享存储上，挂载点唤醒期间，仅遍历的第一次 stat 调用就可能耗时二十秒。因此，对话框打开时先显示不需要读取磁盘的那一半内容（总量、每个候选项、每个保留项及其原因），文件列表随后到达。没有任何内容被省略：用户仍然会在删除任何内容之前阅读每条路径，这就是为什么确认复选框会保持禁用，直到列表显示在界面上——或者在遍历失败时，直到 :meth:`_on_listing_failed` 在列表的位置说明了失败。列表显示占位内容时，该复选框从不启用。

records.context: The statistics are all in :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response` and there is none in here. records.translation: 统计计算全部位于 :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response`，这里没有任何统计计算。本模块是操作界面：选择浓度列、响应列以及（可选的）分组列，即可为每个基因或化合物得到一条曲线及其 EC50 和置信区间，并绘制在读取稀释系列所用的对数坐标轴上。

records.context: Three decisions shape the screen. All three follow from the engine reporting, when it applies, that an experiment does not locate the EC50.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.dose_response#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three decisions shape the screen. All three follow from the engine reporting, when it applies, that an experiment does not locate the EC50.
records.translation: 有三项决定塑造了此界面。这三项都源于引擎在适用时会报告某个实验无法确定 EC50 的位置。

records.context: **Refusals and one-sided bounds are rows, not silence.** A laboratory microplate where three compounds fit and the fourth is cytotoxic at the top dose has four rows. The cytotoxic one says ``refused`` and carries the engine's message; a compound whose midpoint sits past the highest dose says ``unbounded`` and carries ``EC50 > 30 µM``, with an empty EC50 cell. Neither is dropped from the table, so a refused or unbounded fit is not shown as missing data.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.dose_response#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Refusals and one-sided bounds are rows, not silence.** A plate where three compounds fit and the fourth is cytotoxic at the top dose has four rows. The cytotoxic one says ``refused`` and carries the engine's message; a compound whose midpoint sits past the highest dose says ``unbounded`` and carries ``EC50 > 30 µM``, with an empty EC50 cell. Neither is dropped from the table, so a refused or unbounded fit is not shown as missing data.
records.translation: **拒绝拟合和单侧界限会作为行显示，而不是不予显示。** 一块板上三个化合物拟合成功、第四个在最高剂量下具有细胞毒性，就有四行。具有细胞毒性的那一行显示 ``refused``，并附有引擎的消息；中点位于最高剂量之外的化合物显示 ``unbounded``，并附有 ``EC50 > 30 µM``，其 EC50 单元格为空。两者都不会从表中删去，因此被拒绝或无界的拟合不会显示为缺失数据。

records.context: **Every number on this application view comes out of the engine.** The table is :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseSet.table`, the text is :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseResult.report`, and the plotted line is :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseResult.curve`. Nothing is recomputed here, so the figure, the exported CSV and the report text use the same values.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.dose_response#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Every number on this screen comes out of the engine.** The table is :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseSet.table`, the text is :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseResult.report`, and the plotted line is :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseResult.curve`. Nothing is recomputed here, so the figure, the exported CSV and the report text use the same values.
records.translation: **此界面上的每个数字都来自引擎。** 表格是 :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseSet.table`，文本是 :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseResult.report`，绘制的曲线是 :meth:`~spacr.qt.widgets.dose_response.DoseResponseResult.curve`。这里不重新计算任何内容，因此图形、导出的 CSV 和报告文本使用相同的值。

records.context: **The Curve picker offers the asymmetric model and does not choose it.** Fit uses the four-parameter model unless the five-parameter one is chosen, and a five-parameter fit reports an F test of the added parameter (``asymmetry_p``). Picking the better-fitting model per group would give one plate EC50s from two different models.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.dose_response#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The Curve picker offers the asymmetric model and does not choose it.** Fit uses the four-parameter model unless the five-parameter one is chosen, and a five-parameter fit reports an F test of the added parameter (``asymmetry_p``). Picking the better-fitting model per group would give one plate EC50s from two different models.
records.translation: **Curve 选择器提供非对称模型，但不会自动选用它。** 除非选择五参数模型，否则拟合使用四参数模型；五参数拟合会报告对新增参数的 F 检验（``asymmetry_p``）。如果按组挑选拟合更好的模型，就会使同一块板的 EC50s 来自两个不同的模型。

records.context: **The fit runs off the main GUI execution path** through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, like every other read and compute in the Qt layer. A profile-likelihood interval on a 96-compound laboratory microplate is seconds, not milliseconds, and ``threaded=False`` runs the identical code inline so a test drives the same path the shipped application view does.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.dose_response#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The fit runs off the GUI thread** through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, like every other read and compute in the Qt layer. records.translation: **拟合在 GUI 线程之外运行**，与 Qt 层中所有其他读取和计算一样，通过 :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` 进行。在一块含 96 个化合物的板上计算轮廓似然区间需要数秒而不是数毫秒，而 ``threaded=False`` 会以内联方式运行完全相同的代码，使测试经过与正式发布的界面相同的路径。

records.context: :mod:`spacr.foreign` does the work; this screen is for the step that needs review. A foreign ``Area`` can be in µm² where spaCR's ``cell_area`` is in px², so an unreviewed mapping can give values that look plausible and are wrong by a factor of several hundred. So the mapping table is the middle of the screen, it is **editable**, and every edit re-runs the conflict and unit checks in place.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: :mod:`spacr.foreign` does the work; this screen is for the step that needs review. A foreign ``Area`` can be in µm² where spaCR's ``cell_area`` is in px², so an unreviewed mapping can give values that look plausible and are wrong by a factor of several hundred. So the mapping table is the middle of the screen, it is **editable**, and every edit re-runs the conflict and unit checks in place.
records.translation: :mod:`spacr.foreign` 完成实际工作；此界面用于需要审查的那一步。外部的 ``Area`` 可能以 µm² 为单位，而 spaCR 的 ``cell_area`` 以 px² 为单位，因此未经审查的映射可能给出看似合理、实际上相差数百倍的值。因此映射表位于界面中央，它是**可编辑的**，每次编辑都会就地重新运行冲突检查和单位检查。

records.context: **Preview writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.foreign.plan_import` scans, pairs and verifies; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a blocking problem — a target that collides with a spaCR feature name, a measurement table with no object-label column, a microscope field of view whose masks do not pair.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Preview writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.foreign.plan_import` scans, pairs and verifies; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a blocking problem — a target that collides with a spaCR feature name, a measurement table with no object-label column, a field whose masks do not pair.
records.translation: **预览不写入任何内容。** :func:`spacr.foreign.plan_import` 负责扫描、配对和验证；``Import`` 是单独的一次按键，当规划存在阻塞性问题时它保持禁用——例如目标名称与 spaCR 特征名冲突、测量表没有对象标签列、某个视野的掩膜无法配对。

records.context: **Editing is instant and local.** A cell edit calls :meth:`spacr.foreign.ImportPlan.with_column_maps`, which re-resolves the columns without touching the disk, so the unmapped list, the conflict list and the Import button update as you type.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Editing is instant and local.** A cell edit calls :meth:`spacr.foreign.ImportPlan.with_column_maps`, which re-resolves the columns without touching the disk, so the unmapped list, the conflict list and the Import button update as you type.
records.translation: **编辑即时且只在本地生效。** 编辑单元格会调用 :meth:`spacr.foreign.ImportPlan.with_column_maps`，它在不触碰磁盘的情况下重新解析各列，因此未映射列表、冲突列表和 Import 按钮会随输入实时更新。

records.context: **Off the main GUI execution path.** Scanning a plate of TIFFs and reading every label image takes seconds; the import takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the background execution unit and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** Scanning a plate of TIFFs and reading every label image takes seconds; the import takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the worker thread and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **不在 GUI 线程上运行。** 扫描一整块板的 TIFFs 并读取每张标签图像需要数秒；导入需要数分钟。两者都通过 :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 进行，并且完成处理程序通过*绑定方法*（:attr:`ForeignScreen._job_settled`）而不是闭包到达，因为 ``PipelineWorker.finished`` 是在工作线程中发出的，连接到它的闭包会在那里构建控件子对象。测试传入 ``threaded=False``。

records.context: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** Everything lands in the inline status label and the report pane. A QMessageBox would hang a headless run.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.foreign#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** Everything lands in the inline status label and the report pane. A QMessageBox would hang a headless run.
records.translation: **任何错误路径都不弹出模态对话框。** 一切都显示在内联状态标签和报告窗格中。QMessageBox 会使无头运行挂起。

records.source: An edit emits :attr:`mapping_edited` *as well as* ``dataChanged``, and the screen listens to the former. Hanging the live re-resolve off ``dataChanged`` looks equivalent and is not: re-resolving updates the per-row status, updating the status refreshes the tooltips, and refreshing tooltips emits ``dataChanged`` again — one keystroke recursed until the interpreter ran out of stack.
records.translation: 一次编辑会发出 :attr:`mapping_edited`，*同时也*发出 ``dataChanged``，而界面监听的是前者。把实时重新解析挂在 ``dataChanged`` 上看似等价，实则不然：重新解析会更新逐行状态，更新状态会刷新工具提示，而刷新工具提示又会再次发出 ``dataChanged``——一次按键就递归到解释器栈溢出为止。

records.context: A collision is REPORTED, not resolved. Two databases that each hold a laboratory microplate called ``plate1`` are two experiments, and pooling them would compute every per-microplate sample position number over both at once with nothing on application view to say so. The user is told which laboratory microplate ids clash, because they are the only one who can say whether they are the same laboratory microplate.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.gate_editor.GateEditorScreen.load_paths#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A collision is REPORTED, not resolved. Two databases that each hold a plate called ``plate1`` are two experiments, and pooling them would compute every per-well number over both at once with nothing on screen to say so. The user is told which plate ids clash, because they are the only one who can say whether they are the same plate.
records.translation: 冲突会被报告（REPORTED），而不会被自动解决。两个各自含有名为 ``plate1`` 的板的数据库是两个实验，把它们合并会对两者同时计算每个逐孔数值，而没有任何显示来说明这一点。系统会告知用户哪些板 id 冲突，因为只有用户才能判断它们是否是同一块板。

Measured on one workstation, a single ``stat`` under ``/nas_mnt`` -- an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep -- had not returned after twenty seconds, and ``sqlite3.connect`` opens the file before it can read a byte of ``sqlite_master``. records.context: Structurally this is the sibling of :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: a self-contained :class:`QWidget` that owns its own controls, runs the expensive work on a :class:`QThread`, streams results back over signals, reports every failure inline (never in a modal — a QMessageBox hangs a headless run), and pushes a chosen configuration back into the host application view's settings panel through a callback the host registers. Host application views embed it with :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactly the way the Mask application view embeds the live preview, and toggle it with a label reading "Hyperparameter search" where the Mask application view's says "Live".

records.source: Structurally this is the sibling of :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview`: a self-contained :class:`QWidget` that owns its own controls, runs the expensive work on a :class:`QThread`, streams results back over signals, reports every failure inline (never in a modal — a QMessageBox hangs a headless run), and pushes a chosen configuration back into the host screen's settings panel through a callback the host registers. Host screens embed it with :func:`build_hyperparam_card`, exactly the way the Mask screen embeds the live preview, and toggle it with a label reading "Hyperparameter search" where the Mask screen's says "Live".
records.translation: 从结构上看，它是 :mod:`spacr.qt.widgets.live_preview` 的兄弟模块：一个自包含的 :class:`QWidget`，拥有自己的控件，在 :class:`QThread` 上运行耗时工作，通过信号流式回传结果，以内联方式报告每个失败（从不使用模态框——QMessageBox 会使无头运行挂起），并通过宿主注册的回调将所选配置推回宿主界面的设置面板。宿主界面使用 :func:`build_hyperparam_card` 嵌入它，方式与 Mask 界面嵌入实时预览完全相同，并通过一个标签为 "Hyperparameter search" 的开关来切换它，对应于 Mask 界面上写着 "Live" 的那个。

records.context: **Scan writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` walks a sample of the tree and reads each file's own axis metadata; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a problem — because every problem the plan states is a way for the result to be quietly wrong, and the import is the irreversible half.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_import#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Scan writes nothing.** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` walks a sample of the tree and reads each file's own axis metadata; ``Import`` is a separate press, and it stays disabled while the plan has a problem — because every problem the plan states is a way for the result to be quietly wrong, and the import is the irreversible half.
records.translation: **扫描不写入任何内容。** :func:`spacr.image_import.plan_import` 遍历目录树的一个样本，并读取每个文件自身的轴元数据；``Import`` 是单独的一次按键，当规划存在问题时它保持禁用——因为规划所指出的每个问题都可能使结果悄无声息地出错，而导入是不可逆的那一半。

records.context: **The proposal table is not editable, and the answer table is.** A wrong guess is never wrong for one file: it is wrong for a token position, in every name that has one. So the correction is made where the mistake lives, one answer fixing every file that shares it, rather than by retyping eight thousand rows. That is also the only correction :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` can apply without re-walking the disk, which is what makes editing instant.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_import#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The proposal table is not editable, and the answer table is.** A wrong guess is never wrong for one file: it is wrong for a token position, in every name that has one. So the correction is made where the mistake lives, one answer fixing every file that shares it, rather than by retyping eight thousand rows. That is also the only correction :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` can apply without re-walking the disk, which is what makes editing instant.
records.translation: **建议方案表不可编辑，而回答表可编辑。** 错误的猜测从来不会只错在一个文件上：它错在某个标记位置上，涉及所有带有该位置的文件名。因此，修正在错误所在之处进行，一个回答即可修正共享它的所有文件，而不是重新输入八千行。这也是 :meth:`spacr.image_import.ImportPlan.with_mapping` 无需重新遍历磁盘即可应用的唯一修正，这正是编辑能即时生效的原因。

records.context: **Everything the plan could not place is on application view**, with its values, and counted. Silence about unparsed files is how a laboratory microplate imports with a third of its microscope fields of view missing.

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Everything the plan could not place is on screen**, with its values, and counted. Silence about unparsed files is how a plate imports with a third of its fields missing.
records.translation: **规划无法归位的所有内容都显示在界面上**，连同其值并加以计数。对未解析的文件保持沉默，正是一块板在导入时丢失三分之一视野的原因。

records.context: **Off the main GUI execution path.** A scan reads every file's header; an import of a 400-plate archive takes minutes. Both go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, and the completion handler is reached through a *bound method* (:attr:`ImageImportScreen._job_settled`) rather than a closure, because ``PipelineWorker.finished`` is emitted in the background execution unit and a closure connected to it would build widget children there. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_import#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Off the GUI thread.** A scan reads every file's header; an import of a 400-plate archive takes minutes. Tests pass ``threaded=False``.
records.translation: **不在 GUI 线程上运行。** 扫描会读取每个文件的头信息；导入一个 400 块板的归档需要数分钟。两者都通过 :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 进行，并且完成处理程序通过*绑定方法*（:attr:`ImageImportScreen._job_settled`）而不是闭包到达，因为 ``PipelineWorker.finished`` 是在工作线程中发出的，连接到它的闭包会在那里构建控件子对象。测试传入 ``threaded=False``。

records.context: Hover performance

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Hover performance
records.translation: 悬停性能

records.context: A hover handler runs sixty-plus times a second and a PNG decode costs milliseconds, so the obvious implementation — decode the extracted image region under the cursor in ``mouseMoveEvent`` — produces a plot that lags behind the mouse. Three measures keep hover responsive:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A hover handler runs sixty-plus times a second and a PNG decode costs milliseconds, so the obvious implementation — decode the crop under the cursor in ``mouseMoveEvent`` — produces a plot that lags behind the mouse. Three measures keep hover responsive:
records.translation: 悬停处理程序每秒运行六十多次，而一次 PNG 解码需要数毫秒，因此最直接的实现——在 ``mouseMoveEvent`` 中解码光标下的裁剪图——会产生一个落后于鼠标的图。有三项措施保持悬停的响应速度：

records.context: The point cloud is painted once into a pixmap and blitted. Hover repaints a ring, never ninety thousand dots.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The point cloud is painted once into a pixmap and blitted. Hover repaints a ring, never ninety thousand dots.
records.translation: 点云只绘制一次到像素图中，然后进行位块传输。悬停只重绘一个圆环，而从不重绘九万个点。

records.context: Extracted image region paths are resolved for the whole plot in one database pass at load time (:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`), so hover is a key-value mapping lookup rather than a query.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.image_scatter#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Crop paths are resolved for the whole plot in one database pass at load time (:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`), so hover is a dict lookup rather than a query.
records.translation: 在载入时通过一次数据库遍历为整个图解析所有裁剪图路径（:func:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.crop_paths_for_keys`），因此悬停只是一次字典查找，而不是一次查询。

records.context: Decoding is behind a short debounce and an LRU (:class:`spacr.qt.crop_thumbs.CropThumbnails`). Sweeping the cursor across a cluster decodes what the cursor *stopped* on, not everything it crossed; an extracted image region already in the cache appears with no delay at all.

records.context: What is on application view, and why each part is there. The findings table carries the observed rate and the rate expected by coincidence in adjacent columns, with the ratio between them beside both, because a rate alone cannot be told from an accident and this panel exists to stop somebody acting on one. The text window shows reads with their matches coloured by barcode type, because a barcode landing in the same columns on row after row is the evidence that settles an argument a percentage cannot. The proposal shows the value the form holds beside the value the search suggests, so what Apply is about to do is legible before it does it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.map_barcodes.BarcodeSearchPanel#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: What is on screen, and why each part is there. The findings table carries the observed rate and the rate expected by coincidence in adjacent columns, with the ratio between them beside both, because a rate alone cannot be told from an accident and this panel exists to stop somebody acting on one. The text window shows reads with their matches coloured by barcode type, because a barcode landing in the same columns on row after row is the evidence that settles an argument a percentage cannot. The proposal shows the value the form holds beside the value the search suggests, so what Apply is about to do is legible before it does it.
records.translation: 显示了哪些内容，以及每部分为何存在。发现表在相邻的列中给出观测到的比率和偶然情况下预期的比率，两者旁边还有它们的比值，因为单凭一个比率无法与偶然区分开，而此面板的存在正是为了防止有人据此采取行动。文本窗口显示读段，并按条形码类型为匹配部分着色，因为条形码一行接一行地落在相同的列上，才是能够平息百分比所无法平息的争论的证据。建议部分把表单中现有的值与搜索建议的值并列显示，因此 Apply 将要做什么，在其执行之前就一目了然。

records.context: What it costs. Every file is read inside a submitted job, one chunk at a time, so the interface stays live throughout and a search can be abandoned at any point. Cancelling proposes nothing: an interrupted measurement is an honest partial report and a dishonest recommendation.

records.context: The sequencing folder of a real screen holds several samples, and one of them is enough. Which mate carries which barcode, which orientation the reference tables are stored in relative to the reads, and where in the read the barcodes sit are all properties of the library and the sequencing run rather than of a sample, so measuring them on the first sample settles them for every sample beside it. The others are counted rather than read, and the count is reported so that nobody has to wonder whether they were forgotten.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.map_barcodes.plan_barcode_search#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The sequencing folder of a real screen holds several samples, and one of them is enough. Which mate carries which barcode, which orientation the reference tables are stored in relative to the reads, and where in the read the barcodes sit are all properties of the library and the sequencing run rather than of a sample, so measuring them on the first sample settles them for every sample beside it. The others are counted rather than read, and the count is reported so that nobody has to wonder whether they were forgotten.
records.translation: 真实筛选的测序文件夹中包含多个样本，而一个样本就足够了。哪个配对读段携带哪个条形码、参考表相对于读段以哪种方向存储、条形码位于读段中的什么位置，这些都是文库和测序运行的属性，而不是单个样本的属性，因此在第一个样本上测得它们，就能确定与之并列的所有样本。其余样本只计数而不读取，并会报告该数量，这样就没有人需要怀疑它们是否被遗忘了。

records.context: **Provenance is a column, not a tooltip.** "What was this trained on" is what decides whether a model applies to your images at all, so it is in the table and spelled ``unknown`` where it is unknown — a blank cell reads as "no constraints", which is the opposite of what it means.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Provenance is a column, not a tooltip.** "What was this trained on" is what decides whether a model applies to your images at all, so it is in the table and spelled ``unknown`` where it is unknown — a blank cell reads as "no constraints", which is the opposite of what it means.
records.translation: **来源信息是一列，而不是工具提示。** "What was this trained on"（它是用什么训练的）决定了一个模型是否适用于你的图像，因此它放在表格中，未知时写作 ``unknown``——空白单元格会被理解为 "no constraints"（没有限制），这与它的实际含义恰恰相反。

records.context: **Downloads are off the main GUI execution path, atomic, and cancellable.** The bytes go to a temp file inside the destination and are renamed only after the checksum passes (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), so Cancel leaves the destination exactly as it was — no half-written file at a name that looks like a model.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.model_zoo#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Downloads are off the GUI thread, atomic, and cancellable.** The bytes go to a temp file inside the destination and are renamed only after the checksum passes (:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`), so Cancel leaves the destination exactly as it was — no half-written file at a name that looks like a model.
records.translation: **下载在 GUI 线程之外进行，是原子性的，且可以取消。** 字节先写入目标位置内的临时文件，只有在校验和通过后才会重命名（:func:`spacr.model_zoo.fetch`），因此 Cancel 会让目标位置保持原样——不会留下一个名称看起来像模型的半写入文件。

records.context: **No modal dialogs on any error path.** A folder with no models, a checksum mismatch, a corrupt checkpoint, a cancelled download: all inline. A QMessageBox hangs a headless run.

PCA is a property of a population: the centre, the scale and the component directions are all computed from the rows in it. Keeping the old components and dropping the filtered points would draw a plot whose axes belong to a population the user is no longer looking at — the scores would still be in the old basis, and a cluster that separates in the filtered subset would not appear. So the filter is upstream of the maths, the recomputation is debounced, and the report under the plot re-states the row count every time.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.pca#8
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A filter change **recomputes** the decomposition rather than just re-drawing it. PCA is a property of a population: the centre, the scale and the component directions are all computed from the rows in it. Keeping the old components and dropping the filtered points would draw a plot whose axes belong to a population the user is no longer looking at — the scores would still be in the old basis, and a cluster that separates in the filtered subset would not appear. So the filter is upstream of the maths, the recomputation is debounced, and the report under the plot re-states the row count every time.
records.translation: 筛选条件的改变会**重新计算**分解，而不只是重新绘制。PCA 是总体的属性：中心、尺度和成分方向都是根据其中的行计算得出的。保留旧的成分而只去掉被筛选掉的点，绘出的图的坐标轴会属于用户已不再查看的总体——得分仍处于旧的基底中，而在筛选后的子集中能分开的聚类也不会显现。因此，筛选位于数学计算的上游，重新计算带有防抖延迟，图下方的报告每次都会重新说明行数。

records.context: **The graph is drawn from provenance, not from the module list.** What the workflow is *supposed* to do is :data:`spacr.ports.PORTS`, and that is drawn too — dimmed, underneath, as the "declared order" strip — but the boxes and arrows are what actually happened. records.source: **The graph is drawn from provenance, not from the module list.** What the pipeline is *supposed* to do is :data:`spacr.ports.PORTS`, and that is drawn too — dimmed, underneath, as the "declared order" strip — but the boxes and arrows are what actually happened. A project where measure read last week's masks is drawn with that history, which differs from the declared diagram.
records.translation: **图根据来源记录绘制，而不是根据模块列表。** 流程*应该*做什么由 :data:`spacr.ports.PORTS` 规定，它也会被绘制出来——以暗色绘制在下方，作为 "declared order"（声明顺序）条带——但方框和箭头表示的是实际发生的事情。如果某个项目中的 measure 读取的是上周的掩膜，绘出的就是这段历史，它与声明的图示不同。

records.translation: 聚合在 GUI 线程之外运行。``pqc.plate_layout`` 是对整个数据框的分组聚合，``detect_edge_effect`` 则是对其结果的第二轮遍历：在一张真实的测量表上实测耗时 **487 ms**，而且最小对象数微调框每变动一格就会触发一次。拖动该微调框就成了一连串半秒钟的冻结。

records.context: ``recompute()`` returns a bool that a caller reads, and it means "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**" rather than "a plate was drawn". The refusals -- no frame yet, and a failed aggregation -- are unchanged and still synchronous, because the first does no work and the second is reported by the completion handler in exactly the place it was reported before. So the only caller-visible difference is that ``True`` may arrive before the grid is painted.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.plate_view.PlateViewScreen.recompute#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``recompute()`` returns a bool that a caller reads, and it means "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**" rather than "a plate was drawn". So the only caller-visible difference is that ``True`` may arrive before the grid is painted.
records.translation: ``recompute()`` 返回一个调用方会读取的布尔值，其含义是 "a plate was drawn **or is being drawn**"（板已绘制或正在绘制），而不是 "a plate was drawn"（板已绘制）。拒绝的情形——尚无数据框，以及聚合失败——保持不变且仍是同步的，因为前者不做任何工作，而后者由完成处理程序在与之前完全相同的位置报告。因此，调用方唯一能看到的区别是 ``True`` 可能在网格绘制完成之前到达。

records.translation: 左列是 :func:`spacr.profiler.sensitivity`——每个输入按其实际使预测变动的幅度排序，而不是按其系数排序，因为一个从不变化的输入即使系数很大也不会带来任何变动。在包含数千项的设计中，该排名会显示应先分析哪个输入。

records.context: **Nothing is re-fitted.** The screen reads a coefficient table a regression processing session already wrote and wraps it in :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear`, which is *reading* the fit. Re-fitting would show a second model under the first one's name, and on a penalised backend with ``alpha='auto'`` its coefficients can differ. A caller that has a live fitted object can hand it straight to :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model` and skip the file entirely.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.profiler#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Nothing is re-fitted.** The screen reads a coefficient table a regression run already wrote and wraps it in :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear`, which is *reading* the fit. Re-fitting would show a second model under the first one's name, and on a penalised backend with ``alpha='auto'`` its coefficients can differ. A caller that has a live fitted object can hand it straight to :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model` and skip the file entirely.
records.translation: **不会重新拟合任何内容。** 此页面读取回归运行已写出的系数表，并将其包装在 :class:`spacr.profiler.FittedLinear` 中，即*读取*该拟合结果。重新拟合会以第一个模型的名义显示第二个模型，而在使用 ``alpha='auto'`` 的惩罚类后端上，其系数可能不同。持有实时拟合对象的调用方可以将其直接交给 :meth:`ProfilerScreen.set_model`，完全跳过文件。

records.source: The browser has three properties that its design depends on.

records.context: **A project the registry has never seen is still listed.** Projects are found by walking the disk, so a folder copied from a colleague appears the moment the browser is pointed at its parent — with its stage, its size and the date its files were last written. What it does *not* show is "0 stale", which would read as *clean*: with no provenance there is nothing to compare against, so the state column says "unknown — nothing recorded" and the note says why.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.project_browser#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A project the registry has never seen is still listed.** Projects are found by walking the disk, so a folder copied from a colleague appears the moment the browser is pointed at its parent — with its stage, its size and the date its files were last written. What it does *not* show is "0 stale", which would read as *clean*: with no provenance there is nothing to compare against, so the state column says "unknown — nothing recorded" and the note says why.
records.translation: **注册表从未见过的项目仍会列出。** 项目是通过遍历磁盘找到的，因此从同事那里复制来的文件夹，在浏览器指向其父文件夹的那一刻就会出现——连同其阶段、大小以及其文件最后写入的日期。它*不会*显示的是 "0 stale"，因为那会被理解为*干净*：没有来源记录就没有可比较的对象，因此状态列显示 "unknown — nothing recorded"（未知——没有任何记录），备注会说明原因。

records.context: **The scan never blocks the window.** Walking a plate folder is tens of thousands of ``stat`` calls, and doing it on the main GUI execution path would freeze the application for however long the filesystem takes. Everything goes through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, whose completion handlers here are **bound methods** — read that module's docstring for what a closure connected to ``thread.finished`` costs. The background activity spinner follows the processing session registry on its own, so nothing here has to drive it.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.project_browser#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The scan never blocks the window.** Walking a plate folder is tens of thousands of ``stat`` calls, and doing it on the GUI thread would freeze the application for however long the filesystem takes. Everything goes through :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner`, whose completion handlers here are **bound methods** — read that module's docstring for what a closure connected to ``thread.finished`` costs. The background activity spinner follows the run registry on its own, so nothing here has to drive it.
records.translation: **扫描从不阻塞窗口。** 遍历一个板文件夹需要数万次 ``stat`` 调用，在 GUI 线程上执行会使应用冻结，时长取决于文件系统的响应速度。一切都通过 :class:`spacr.qt.job_runner.JobRunner` 进行，这里的完成处理程序都是**绑定方法**——关于连接到 ``thread.finished`` 的闭包会带来什么代价，请阅读该模块的文档字符串。后台活动指示器会自行跟随运行注册表，因此这里无需驱动它。

records.context: **And neither does opening the application view, nor opening its folder chooser.** Two things here take a path the user typed on some *other* application view: the search folders :func:`make_project_browser_screen` seeds from the recent-source list, and the folder the "Add folder…" dialog starts in. Neither is checked with ``os.path.isdir`` on the main GUI execution path: measured on one workstation, one such folder was under an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep, and a single ``isdir`` on it had not returned after twenty seconds, freezing the whole application with no traceback. Both ask :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, which answers from a cache and stats in the background. Those two are the whole inventory: the walk executes on a worker, and every column, note and detail line the application view draws is rendered from the frozen :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` that walk already returned, so filling the table and the detail pane reads nothing.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.project_browser#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **And neither does opening the screen, nor opening its folder chooser.** Two things here take a path the user typed on some *other* screen: the search folders :func:`make_project_browser_screen` seeds from the recent-source list, and the folder the "Add folder…" dialog starts in. Neither is checked with ``os.path.isdir`` on the GUI thread: measured on one workstation, one such folder was under an ``autofs`` mount whose share was asleep, and a single ``isdir`` on it had not returned after twenty seconds, freezing the whole application with no traceback. Both ask :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`, which answers from a cache and stats in the background. Those two are the whole inventory: the walk runs on a worker, and every column, note and detail line the screen draws is rendered from the frozen :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` that walk already returned, so filling the table and the detail pane reads nothing.
records.translation: **打开此界面及其文件夹选择器也不会阻塞。** 这里有两处会用到用户在某个*其他*界面上输入的路径：:func:`make_project_browser_screen` 从最近使用的源列表中预填的搜索文件夹，以及 "Add folder…" 对话框的起始文件夹。两者都不会在 GUI 线程上用 ``os.path.isdir`` 检查：在一台工作站上测得，其中一个文件夹位于一个共享存储处于休眠状态的 ``autofs`` 挂载点下，对其执行一次 ``isdir`` 二十秒后仍未返回，使整个应用冻结且没有任何回溯信息。两者都会询问 :mod:`spacr.qt.path_probe`，它根据缓存作答并在后台执行 stat。这两处就是全部：遍历在工作线程上运行，界面所绘制的每一列、每条备注和每行详细信息，都根据该遍历已经返回的冻结 :class:`spacr.projects.ProjectSummary` 渲染，因此填充表格和详细信息窗格不会读取任何内容。

records.context: ``_QueueRunner`` is parented to this widget and executes whole workflows, so its independent execution path can be hours long. Destroying the application view with it executing deletes a live QThread, which Qt answers with ``qFatal("QThread: Destroyed while thread is still running")``. It also does not go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, so the process-wide run registry — and therefore ``MainWindow.closeEvent``'s drain — cannot see it.

It also does not go through :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread`, so the process-wide run registry — and therefore ``MainWindow.closeEvent``'s drain — cannot see it.

records.context: Three screening experiments continue from a regression's coefficients, and none of them duplicates anything the results panel does:
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Three screens continue from a regression's coefficients, and none of them duplicates anything the results panel does:
records.translation: 有三个页面承接回归的系数，而且它们都不重复结果面板所做的任何工作：

records.context: **Volcano Explorer** is the only publication-figure path in spaCR. Its volcano is a matplotlib render behind a 56-field style that can be saved and reloaded as JSON, every called point labelled, colour or shape driven by an annotation file merged on an inferred structured-data name, arbitrary x/y columns, and a vector re-render at journal size. The panel's own volcano is pyqtgraph and can honour none of it, so the explorer is offered from that plot's own menu as "Publication figure…", seeded with the frame already on application view.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Volcano Explorer** is the only publication-figure path in spaCR. Its volcano is a matplotlib render behind a 56-field style that can be saved and reloaded as JSON, every called point labelled, colour or shape driven by an annotation file merged on an inferred key, arbitrary x/y columns, and a vector re-render at journal size. The panel's own volcano is pyqtgraph and can honour none of it, so the explorer is offered from that plot's own menu as "Publication figure…", seeded with the frame already on screen.
records.translation: **Volcano Explorer** 是 spaCR 中唯一的出版级图形路径。其火山图是基于 56 个字段样式的 matplotlib 渲染，该样式可以保存为 JSON 并重新载入；每个判定的点都有标签，颜色或形状由按推断的键合并进来的注释文件驱动，可使用任意 x/y 列，并能以期刊尺寸重新渲染为矢量图。面板自身的火山图使用 pyqtgraph，无法支持其中任何一项，因此探索器作为 "Publication figure…" 出现在该图自身的菜单中，并以当前显示的数据框为初始数据。

records.context: **Hit List** displays one ranked row per gene for the loaded regression processing session. Backends that report p-values receive Benjamini–Hochberg q-values computed across the genes tested; penalised backends instead rank by bootstrap selection frequency and do not report q-values. Each row includes the effect estimate, a 95% interval when a standard error is available, and gRNA sign agreement when guide-level coefficients are available. Annotation CSVs are collapsed to one row per gene before validated many-to-one joins. The complete :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` is installed as the **Hits** tab after Guide support, follows the processing session loaded by the results panel, and exports the displayed filtered list as CSV, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Hit List** displays one ranked row per gene for the loaded regression run. Backends that report p-values receive Benjamini–Hochberg q-values computed across the genes tested; penalised backends instead rank by bootstrap selection frequency and do not report q-values. Each row includes the effect estimate, a 95% interval when a standard error is available, and gRNA sign agreement when guide-level coefficients are available. Annotation CSVs are collapsed to one row per gene before validated many-to-one joins. The complete :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` is installed as the **Hits** tab after Guide support, follows the run loaded by the results panel, and exports the displayed filtered list as CSV, Markdown, or self-contained HTML.
records.translation: **Hit List** 为已载入的回归运行显示每个基因一行的排序结果。报告 p 值的后端会得到在所检验的基因间计算的 Benjamini–Hochberg q 值；惩罚类后端则按 bootstrap 选择频率排序，不报告 q 值。每一行包含效应估计值；有标准误时包含 95% 区间；有向导序列级系数时包含 gRNA 符号一致性。注释 CSVs 在经过验证的多对一连接之前会先折叠为每个基因一行。完整的 :class:`~spacr.qt.screens.hit_list.HitListScreen` 作为 **Hits** 选项卡安装在 Guide support 之后，跟随结果面板所载入的运行，并可将显示的已过滤列表导出为 CSV、Markdown 或自包含的 HTML。

records.context: **Methods & Results** builds the processing-session digest -- package versions, timings, seed and error policy, per-module parameters parsed out of the emitted macro, the segmentation verdict, artifact counts, held-out metrics -- drafts the two sections from it and then mechanically checks every number in the draft back against the digest. It opens seeded with the project the regression screen is already pointed at, so the path it otherwise asks the user to type is filled in.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#4
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Methods & Results** builds the run digest -- package versions, timings, seed and error policy, per-module parameters parsed out of the emitted macro, the segmentation verdict, artifact counts, held-out metrics -- drafts the two sections from it and then mechanically checks every number in the draft back against the digest. It opens seeded with the project the regression screen is already pointed at, so the path it otherwise asks the user to type is filled in.
records.translation: **Methods & Results** 会构建运行摘要——软件包版本、耗时、随机种子和错误策略、从生成的宏中解析出的逐模块参数、分割判定、产物计数、留出数据指标——据此起草两个部分，然后机械地将草稿中的每个数字与摘要进行核对。它打开时会预填回归页面已经指向的项目，因此原本需要用户输入的路径已经填好。

records.context: Each of the three is also a button on the Regression masthead: the module's own icon with no text, its one-line description as the tooltip, lit on hover in the maturity colour its tile used -- see :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`. Each button opens the same component as the panel's own entry point: the Hit List button raises the Hits tab rather than opening a second hit list, and the Volcano Explorer button opens exactly what "Publication figure…" opens.

records.source: Each of the three is also a button on the Regression masthead: the module's own icon with no text, its one-line description as the tooltip, lit on hover in the maturity colour its tile used -- see :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`. Each button opens the same component as the panel's own entry point: the Hit List button raises the Hits tab rather than opening a second hit list, and the Volcano Explorer button opens exactly what "Publication figure…" opens.
records.translation: 这三者在 Regression 标题栏上也各有一个按钮：使用模块自身的图标、不带文字，一行描述作为工具提示，悬停时以其图块所用的成熟度颜色点亮——参见 :class:`spacr.qt.widgets.fold_strip.FoldStrip`。每个按钮打开的组件都与面板自身的入口相同：Hit List 按钮会将 Hits 选项卡置于前台，而不是打开第二个命中列表；Volcano Explorer 按钮打开的正是 "Publication figure…" 所打开的内容。

records.context: Each volcano shows one correction family. A guide permutation writes every minimum-support family stacked into one long table, and fits one family per response when several outcomes were fitted. Each of those is its own Benjamini-Hochberg family, so drawing the table unfiltered puts a guide on the plot two to four times at different heights and pools two corrections into one picture. :func:`single_correction_family` is the cut, and :func:`install_correction_families` puts it in front of the panel's own ``set_frame`` so every route into the panel -- a finished processing session, a folder opened by hand, a dropped bundle -- draws one family.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.regression#6
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Each volcano shows one correction family. A guide permutation writes every minimum-support family stacked into one long table, and fits one family per response when several outcomes were fitted. Each of those is its own Benjamini-Hochberg family, so drawing the table unfiltered puts a guide on the plot two to four times at different heights and pools two corrections into one picture. :func:`single_correction_family` is the cut, and :func:`install_correction_families` puts it in front of the panel's own ``set_frame`` so every route into the panel -- a finished run, a folder opened by hand, a dropped bundle -- draws one family.
records.translation: 每张火山图只显示一个校正族。向导序列置换会把每个最小支持度族堆叠写入一张长表；当拟合了多个结果变量时，还会为每个响应拟合一个族。其中每一个都是独立的 Benjamini-Hochberg 族，因此不加过滤地绘制该表，会让同一条向导序列以不同高度在图上出现两到四次，并把两种校正混在同一张图中。:func:`single_correction_family` 负责这一截取，而 :func:`install_correction_families` 将其放在面板自身的 ``set_frame`` 之前，使进入面板的每条路径——完成的运行、手动打开的文件夹、拖入的结果包——都只绘制一个族。

records.source: Called at import time so that importing this module is all it takes for the app to exist. It returns rather than raises on a duplicate key so a re-import (a reloaded module, a test that cleared the registry) is a no-op instead of failing the import.
records.translation: 在导入时调用，因此只要导入本模块，该应用就会存在。遇到重复的键时返回而不是引发异常，因此重新导入（重新载入的模块、清空了注册表的测试）不会产生任何作用，而不会导致导入失败。

records.context: It is also named in ``spacr.qt.app._SELF_REGISTERING_APPS`` and in :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`. The redundancy is deliberate: the first is what makes the row exist under a bare ``import spacr.qt.app`` — an inventory that depended on whether something else had imported this module is an inventory that fails on whichever file pytest collected first — and the second is the launch path, which must still work if the first ever fails. All three calls land on this function and it registers once.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.run_compare.register#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: It is also named in ``spacr.qt.app._SELF_REGISTERING_APPS`` and in :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES`. The redundancy is deliberate: the first is what makes the row exist under a bare ``import spacr.qt.app`` — an inventory that depended on whether something else had imported this module is an inventory that fails on whichever file pytest collected first — and the second is the launch path, which must still work if the first ever fails. All three calls land on this function and it registers once.
records.translation: 它也列在 ``spacr.qt.app._SELF_REGISTERING_APPS`` 和 :data:`spacr.qt.SELF_REGISTERING_MODULES` 中。这种冗余是有意的：前者使该行在单纯 ``import spacr.qt.app`` 时就存在——如果应用清单取决于是否有其他东西已经导入了本模块，那么无论 pytest 先收集哪个文件，它都会失败——后者则是启动路径，即使前者失效也必须仍能工作。三次调用都落在此函数上，而它只注册一次。

records.context: Without this the screen could be destroyed with its refresh still executing. The job survives — ``bridge.make_thread`` registers it process-wide — but it survives *ownerless*, and an ownerless job in the processing session registry is what ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` reads when it decides whether the application may quit.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.run_history.RunHistoryScreen.closeEvent#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Without this the screen could be destroyed with its refresh still running. The job survives — ``bridge.make_thread`` registers it process-wide — but it survives *ownerless*, and an ownerless job in the run registry is what ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` reads when it decides whether the application may quit.
records.translation: 如果没有这一步，界面可能会在其刷新仍在运行时被销毁。作业会存活下来——``bridge.make_thread`` 会在全进程范围内登记它——但它会在*无所有者*的状态下存活，而运行注册表中无所有者的作业，正是 ``MainWindow.closeEvent`` 在决定应用能否退出时所读取的内容。

records.context: When the active tab changes, settings named by the ``cellpose_masks`` propagation map in :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` are copied to the destination tab when that tab exposes the corresponding setting. ``src`` and ``model_name`` are not copied. On entry to Apply, the workbench searches ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` for checkpoints whose names begin with the Train tab's ``model_name``. It prefers completed checkpoints over periodic ``_epoch_`` checkpoints and selects the most recently modified candidate from the preferred group. If found, that path is assigned to ``custom_model``, which :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolves before ``model_name``; otherwise, Apply retains its current model selection.

records.source: When the active tab changes, settings named by the ``cellpose_masks`` propagation map in :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` are copied to the destination tab when that tab exposes the corresponding setting. ``src`` and ``model_name`` are not copied. On entry to Apply, the workbench searches ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` for checkpoints whose names begin with the Train tab's ``model_name``. It prefers completed checkpoints over periodic ``_epoch_`` checkpoints and selects the most recently modified candidate from the preferred group. If found, that path is assigned to ``custom_model``, which :func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` resolves before ``model_name``; otherwise, Apply retains its current model selection.
records.translation: 当活动选项卡改变时，``cellpose_masks`` 传播映射（位于 :mod:`spacr.qt.preview_registry` 中）所指定的设置，会在目标选项卡提供相应设置时复制到该选项卡。``src`` 和 ``model_name`` 不会被复制。进入 Apply 时，工作台会在 ``<train-src>/models/cellpose_model/models`` 中搜索名称以 Train 选项卡的 ``model_name`` 开头的检查点。它优先选择已完成的检查点，而不是周期性的 ``_epoch_`` 检查点，并从优先组中选出最近修改的候选项。如果找到，该路径会被赋给 ``custom_model``，:func:`spacr.spacr_cellpose.identify_masks_finetune` 会先于 ``model_name`` 解析它；否则，Apply 保留其当前的模型选择。

records.source: A settings CSV, a restored session or a recipe belongs to one of the two modules, and applying it to both would write a training folder into the Apply tab's path field — the one thing the two-field split exists to prevent. The tab is chosen by which one owns more of the keys the OTHER one does not have, so ``n_epochs`` picks Train and ``flow_threshold`` picks Apply; a dict that distinguishes neither goes to the tab already on screen. The chosen tab is raised, so the settings are visible where they landed.
records.translation: 设置 CSV、恢复的会话或配方都属于两个模块之一，如果同时应用到两者，就会把训练文件夹写进 Apply 选项卡的路径字段——而这正是拆分为两个字段所要防止的事情。选项卡的选择依据是：哪一方拥有更多另一方（OTHER）所没有的键，因此 ``n_epochs`` 会选中 Train，``flow_threshold`` 会选中 Apply；无法区分两者的字典则交给当前显示的选项卡。被选中的选项卡会置于前台，使设置在其落地之处可见。

records.source: **Discovery runs off the GUI thread.** A scan walks a model tree and parses every progress CSV under it, which on a real screen is hundreds of files. records.translation: **发现过程在 GUI 线程之外运行。** 扫描会遍历模型目录树并解析其下的每个进度 CSV，在真实的筛选实验中这有数百个文件。它与其他所有 spaCR 作业一样通过 :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.make_thread` 进行；测试传入 ``threaded=False``，以内联方式运行相同的代码。绘制保留在 GUI 线程上——到那时数据已经在内存中了。

records.context: ``FigureCanvasQT.__init__`` sets ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` and a white palette, and the figure carries a solid ``facecolor``. Three opaque things stacked: the area right of "Runs found" was a flat dark rectangle whatever the page-opacity slider said, with square corners where every other container on the page has rounded ones.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_compare.panel_canvas_class#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: ``FigureCanvasQT.__init__`` sets ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` and a white palette, and the figure carries a solid ``facecolor``. Three opaque things stacked: the area right of "Runs found" was a flat dark rectangle whatever the page-opacity slider said, with square corners where every other container on the page has rounded ones.
records.translation: ``FigureCanvasQT.__init__`` 会设置 ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` 和白色调色板，而图形带有纯色的 ``facecolor``。三个不透明的东西叠在一起：无论页面不透明度滑块如何设置，"Runs found" 右侧的区域都是一块深色的纯色矩形，而且页面上其他每个容器都是圆角，唯独它是直角。

records.context: QSS cannot fix that — a ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` widget never lets the sheet's background through, and a stylesheet cannot round a canvas matplotlib draws edge to edge. So the panel is drawn in ``paintEvent``, underneath the figure, and the figure's own patch is made fully transparent so the panel is what shows.
records.label: spacr.qt.screens.train_compare.panel_canvas_class#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: QSS cannot fix that — a ``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` widget never lets the sheet's background through, and a stylesheet cannot round a canvas matplotlib draws edge to edge. So the panel is drawn in ``paintEvent``, underneath the figure, and the figure's own patch is made fully transparent so the panel is what shows.
records.translation: QSS 无法解决这个问题——``WA_OpaquePaintEvent`` 控件从不让样式表的背景透出，而且样式表也无法给 matplotlib 从边到边绘制的画布加圆角。因此，面板在 ``paintEvent`` 中绘制于图形下方，并将图形自身的底片设为完全透明，使显示出来的是面板。

records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Built lazily and cached: no screen in this package imports matplotlib at module scope, and subclassing its Qt backend would do exactly that.
records.translation: 延迟构建并缓存：本包中没有任何界面在模块作用域导入 matplotlib，而继承其 Qt 后端恰恰会这样做。
